method: DAG critical path plus single-player active-work lower bound; shared farm/cave/quest activities counted once; not an exact optimal scheduler or human playtest
fixes_modeled: Non-festival bench can no longer skip 12 hours every day. One chapter7 fast-forward remains.
Arrival air proof cannot be replaced by checkpoint air refill.
No diamond drop-rate nerf; rare veins fixed guaranteed outputs. Paid original-mine surveys remain a legal faster route with actual supplies, energy and processing queues.
Recent gift history window3 allows four useful gifts to rotate; repeated identical gifts still zero.
assumptions: Operation seconds, walking detours, reading time, well acquisition day and visit frequency are explicit sampled assumptions, not measured players.

The farm model starts with120 coins/24 seeds, 60 max plots, actual crop prices/growth, stamina, deterministic rain and later irrigation access. Village material collection uses accumulated spare farming energy (123 stamina budget before early facilities) and is charged in main/supply work, not invented free crops.
Relation100 depends on quests12/trials; it is not added as an independent 100-day grind. Management120 includes quest30. Cave80–100 is shared with first abyss descent.
Concurrent waiting windows use max(), with sum of unique active work as a one-player lower bound; travel/task ordering conflicts may add more time. New local diagnostics are required to calibrate.
Farm/queue/ore day constraints use ordinary7–9 minute days. Calendar waiting is not counted as entertaining content.
Floor active-game-hour yield uses an ideal entry/ore/exit route,0.9s per hit and30 real seconds per game hour; it excludes inter-floor/processing/logistics and is not a global farming rate.
Parts.finish_h is the dependency earliest finish; total also respects the one-player active-work bound. It is not a proven feasible optimal schedule.
No claimed 200–350h attainment; extending current content to that range would predominantly add repetition/waiting.
